# Dume.ai Documentation

Dume.ai is an AI Executive Assistant that simplifies your workday through intelligent automation, tool integration, and workflow management.

## Getting Started
- [Introduction](/index) - Overview of Dume.ai and quick start guide
- [Personalization](/getting-started/personalisation) - Customize your AI assistant
- [Connect Tools](/getting-started/connect-your-first-tool) - Link your first integration
- [Chat Interface](/getting-started/chat-interface) - Learn to communicate with your AI assistant

## Integrations
- [Email Integration](/integrations/email) - Gmail integration and email management
- [Calendar Integration](/integrations/calendar) - Google Calendar scheduling and management
- [GitHub Integration](/integrations/github) - Repository management and PR reviews
- [Jira Integration](/integrations/jira) - Ticket creation and project management
- [Confluence Integration](/integrations/confluence) - Document search and creation
- [Notion Integration](/integrations/notion) - Knowledge base management
- [Google Docs](/integrations/google_docs) - Document creation and editing
- [Google Sheets](/integrations/google_sheets) - Spreadsheet management
- [Microsoft Integration](/integrations/microsoft) - Office 365 and Teams integration

## Tools
- [Artifacts](/tools/artifacts) - Create and manage documents, spreadsheets, code, and images
- [Charts](/tools/charts) - Interactive data visualization and chart creation
- [Web Search](/tools/web-search) - AI-powered internet research tools
- [Web Scraper](/tools/web-scraper) - Intelligent data extraction from websites
- [People Search](/tools/people-search) - Professional contact discovery
- [Notifications](/tools/notification) - Automated email alerts and notifications

## Workflows
- [Workflow Builder](/workflows/getting-started) - Create custom automation sequences
- [Workflow Nodes](/workflows/input-node) - Available workflow building blocks
- [Workflow Examples](/workflow-examples/linkdin-generator) - Pre-built workflow templates

## Key Features
- **20+ Tool Integrations**: Connect with popular business tools
- **Workflow Automation**: Create custom automation sequences
- **Natural Language Interface**: Communicate using conversational language
- **AI-Powered Assistance**: Intelligent help with daily tasks
- **Executive Productivity**: Designed for business professionals and leaders
- **Cross-Platform**: Available on web, mobile, and desktop

## Common Use Cases
- Email management and drafting
- Calendar scheduling and meeting coordination
- Document creation and editing
- Project management and task tracking
- Data analysis and visualization
- Research and information gathering
- Team collaboration and communication
- Workflow automation and process optimization

For comprehensive documentation and tutorials, visit https://docs.dume.ai
